PositionRiskBudget.description: Target shares of portfolio VaR checked against the decomposition.

targets.description:
Target fraction of portfolio VaR per position, in `[0, 1]` and summing
to ~1.0, in position order.

utilization_threshold.description:
Actual-to-target ratio above which a breach is flagged; omitted uses
[`super::DEFAULT_UTILIZATION_THRESHOLD`].

PositionRiskSource.description: Where a position VaR/ES decomposition comes from.

compute_incremental.description:
Also compute leave-one-out incremental VaR (one repricing per
position); omitted is `false`.

covariance.description:
Position-return covariance: `n x n` rows in position order,
symmetric positive semidefinite.

weights.description:
Position weights or exposures in portfolio currency, one per
position id.

oneOf.description:
Historical simulation over scenario P&L; also yields the tail stress
attribution.

pnls.description:
Position-major scenario P&L: one row per position, one column per
scenario, losses negative.

description: One position risk report request: position ids, confidence, a parametric or historical source and an optional budget.

budget.description: Risk budget to evaluate against the decomposition; omitted skips it.

confidence.description:
Tail confidence as a decimal strictly inside `(0.5, 1)`; omitted is
`0.95`.

position_ids.description: Position identifiers, in the order of the source's rows.

source.description: Parametric covariance or historical scenario P&L.

title: PositionRiskRequest
